contract: Socket.IO notifications_updated is emitted to every connected authenticated client (admin and non-admin) with one object argument, the whole notification settings document, after an admitted trigger; it is not emitted for a rejected or unadmitted trigger, and repeated triggers emit one event each in order.
exceptions: initial, repeat, changed, force and failure facets are covered by the listed scenarios.
The payload is compared field by field with the whole settings document; lastFiredAt is validated as a live timestamp. The event name is the only Socket.IO event this capability owns.

invariants.contract: notifications_updated carries exactly one object argument, the full settings document, with JSON types a client reads (strings for id/appriseType/appriseApiUrl/eventName/templates/type, number for notificationDelay and the counters, booleans for enabled/lastAttemptFailed, array for urls and null for absent values); repeated triggers emit one event each in trigger order; the payload reflects a settings or record write made before the trigger; no event is emitted when the settings are unusable; the fail override payload carries the disabled record.

notifications_updated reaches every connected authenticated socket, the admin and the fixture non-admin user, with an identical payload and never an unauthenticated socket; a rejected trigger sends it to nobody.
